title: Patch: Your Table skips tokens, adds many more stats and shuffles them with no arrows
thread:
**Issue #1743 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1743: Patch: Your Table skips tokens, adds many more stats and shuffles them with no arrows
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

"Your table", the landing's floor below the first screen (R639, R1582000, R1583000, R1584000; `apps/web/src/stats/`), shows ten stats in a fixed order, with ‹ › arrows and a dot per stat. That makes it feel short and countable. This patch makes it feel like it could go on forever. **Volume is the point:** with enough stats, no single one feels boring, so every stat below ships.

**1. Tokens are never a stat's card.** At the moment `topCard` in `stats/showcase.ts` takes the top card the catalog holds, so a token (`def.token === true`, such as a summoned 1/1) can win Old Faithful, Fallen Hero, Survivor and the rest just because it gets made so often. Every stat skips a card whose catalog entry is a token and takes the next one, the same way it already skips a card the catalog no longer holds. That includes the Pocket Pick and The Record's card, and every new stat below. The tally itself (`model.ts`, `track.ts`, `store.ts`, `sync.ts`) is unchanged and still counts tokens. Only the showcase's choice of card filters them.

**2. Twenty-five new stats.** Add every stat below to `showcaseStats`, each with a title, a card (never a token), a line and one of the board's existing stage animations (`showcaseStage.ts`; nothing new to animate, as R1584000 says). Together with the existing ten, that makes 35. A stat the device has no data for is still left out. "Per play" stats need a minimum number of plays, `SHOWCASE_MIN_PLAYS` in `stats/config.ts` (CLAUDE.md rule 9), so that one game doesn't win them.

*From the counters the device already keeps* (no storage change):

| Stat | Its card | Its line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Glass Cannon** | Your card with the highest `destroyed` per play | "destroyed 8 of the 10 times you played it" | death, you |
| **Unbreakable** | Your most-played card with `destroyed` 0 | "played 12×, never destroyed" | shield |
| **Grudge Match** | Highest min(`played`, `playedAgainst`) | "you 7×, them 9×" | lunge |
| **Never Tried It** | Most `playedAgainst` with `played` 0 | "faced 11×, never played it yourself" | lunge, opponent |
| **Easy Target** | Highest `defeated` per `playedAgainst` | "taken down 9 of the 10 times you faced it" | death, opponent |
| **The Closer** | Highest `lethal` per play | "the winning blow in 3 of 5 plays" | lunge |
| **Hair Trigger** | The Trap with the highest `sprung` per play | "sprung 6 of the 7 times you set it" | trap |
| **Ride or Die** | Highest `survived` per play | "still standing 5 of the 6 times you played it" | shield |
| **Familiar Face** | Highest `seen` | "in 34 of your 50 games" | radiant |
| **One-Hit Wonder** | A card with `played` exactly 1, chosen with the showcase's random source | "played once. Just once." | entrance |
| **Second Fiddle** | Your #2 most-played card | "your #2, played 7×" | entrance |
| **Bronze Medal** | Your #3 most-played card | "your #3, played 5×" | entrance |
| **Explorer** | A card you have played, chosen at random | "87 different cards played" | entrance |
| **Collector** | A card you have seen, chosen at random | "seen 212 of 480 cards" (out of the shipped sets' non-token cards) | radiant |

*From new per-card counters, read from events the views already carry* (`damage`, `attackDeclared`, `healed`, `drawn`, `radiantSet`, `turnStarted`). R97 still applies: a counter only ever names a card the view shows, from the viewer's seat.

| Stat | New counter | Its line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Workhorse** | `damageDealt`: the sum of `damage` amounts whose `sourceId` is your card | "dealt 312 damage" | lunge |
| **Heavy Hitter** | `biggestHit`: the largest single such `damage`. It keeps a **maximum**, not a sum, so `addGame` takes the max | "hit for 14 once" | lunge |
| **Overkill** | `overkill`: the largest amount by which one of your card's hits went past its target's health, read from the target's health in the previous view | "hit 9 harder than it needed to" | lunge |
| **Brawler** | `attacks`: each `attackDeclared` by your card | "attacked 41×" | lunge |
| **Medic** | `healing`: `healed` has no source, so a heal counts toward your card whose `cardPlayed`, `activated` or `trapFired` is in the same batch. A heal with no such card counts nothing | "healed 96" | shield |
| **Card Shark** | `drawn`: each of your `drawn` that shows the card | "drawn 19×" | entrance |
| **Shine On** | `radiant`: each `radiantSet` on your card | "made Radiant 6×" | radiant |
| **Comeback Kid** | `playedInWin`: games you won in which you played the card. Shows the highest win share, at least `SHOWCASE_MIN_PLAYS` games | "won 9 of the 11 games you played it in" | radiant |
| **Jinx** | `playedInLoss`: games you lost in which you played the card. Shows the highest loss share, at least `SHOWCASE_MIN_PLAYS` games | "lost 7 of the 9 games you played it in" | death, you |

*Game-level (new totals beside `games` / `wins` / `losses` / `draws`)*:

| Stat | New total | Its card | Its line | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Hot Streak** | `streak` and `bestStreak` (the current and best win streaks; a loss or draw resets `streak`) | Your most-played card | "best streak: 6 wins" | radiant |
| **Marathon** | `longestGame`: the most `turnStarted` turns in one finished game | Your most-played card in that game, else your most-played card overall | "longest game: 23 turns" | entrance |

A new counter or total is stored under the same key and version, read as 0 when missing (and when it isn't a whole positive number), and cleared by Clear, as R1582000 did. None of them syncs (R1142000; `sync.ts`'s pruning stays as it is). All twenty-five ship. If one truly can't be read from what the views show, the builder must say so in the ruling note with the reason, and must not quietly drop it.

**3. A random order.** The showcase draws stats from the page's injected random source, the way the fan does (`LandingRoute`'s `random`, R374), not in `showcaseStats`'s order. Use a shuffled bag: every available stat appears once before any repeats, and a reshuffle never puts the stat just shown first. `showcaseStats` can still return a list. The order is the showcase's job.

**4. No arrows, no dots.** Remove the ‹ › buttons and the dot row (`landing-showcase-controls`, the `showcasePrev` / `showcaseNext` / `landingShowcasePickTestid` testids and their CSS in `routes/landing.css`). The dots give away how many stats there are, which works against the "infinite" feel. Clicking, tapping, Enter or Space on the showcase moves to the next random stat, so keyboard and reduced-motion players can still step through it. Under reduced motion it still never moves on by itself (R1584000's holds stand), but a tap moves it. The pointer, focus and hidden-page holds stay.

### Acceptance

- A ruling note in this issue's block amends R1584000 (and R1582000 for the new counters), with proving tests named after it (CLAUDE.md rule 3). `cargo jackioh spec index` and `spec check` pass.
- `showcase.test.ts`: a tally where a token tops every counter shows no stat on the token, and each stat falls through to the top non-token card. A Pocket Pick on a token is dropped.
- `showcase.test.ts`: all 25 new stat keys exist. Each has a test for its card choice (ties go to the lower id; the random picks follow a seeded source), its line, the `SHOWCASE_MIN_PLAYS` floor where it applies, and being left out when it has no data.
- `model.test.ts` / `track.test.ts` / `store.test.ts`: each new counter and total is counted from its events from the viewer's seat, never names a hidden card, reads as 0 from an older stored value, and is emptied by Clear. `biggestHit` and `overkill` merge by max. The streak resets on a loss or draw. A heal with no card in its batch counts nothing. `sync.test.ts` shows none of them is sent.
- `StatShowcase.test.tsx`: with a seeded random source, the order follows the seed. Every stat appears once before any repeats, and no stat shows twice in a row across a reshuffle. There is no prev, next or pick control in the DOM. A click or Enter moves to another stat, including under reduced motion.
- `landing.test.tsx` and the component spec `e2e/cypress/component/landing-and-code-field.cy.tsx` are updated for the removed controls.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.

### Blocked by, part of

None. Amends R1584000 (#1584, part of #1576).
```
